{{Sequel Disambiguation}} __notoc__
This page is for documenting the patch notes of Slay the Spire 2, including any updates before the early access release, as these are still visible through the in-game patch notes menu.

Patches with a date instead of a version number were patches made before the developers changed the game's engine from Unity to Godot.
